# Whosoever Believes

> Whosoever Believes is a Free Grace theology website offering articles, Bible study tools, and discipleship resources. The site teaches that eternal life is received by faith alone in Christ alone, apart from works — consistent with the theology of the Grace Evangelical Society (GES). It is authored by Jonathan Crow, a seminary student, and serves as a resource hub for the Crab Bible Study community.

The site name comes from John 3:16 — the Greek phrase πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων ("everyone who believes") — emphasizing that anyone who believes in Jesus Christ receives the free gift of eternal life. The theological position is Free Grace, which holds:

- Eternal life is received the moment a person believes in Jesus Christ for it (John 3:16; 5:24; 6:47).
- Faith alone is the sole condition; no works, commitment, or perseverance is required to receive or keep eternal life.
- Assurance of salvation is of the essence of saving faith — a believer can and should know they have eternal life (1 John 5:13).
- Justification and sanctification are distinct. Believers can and do sin, but their eternal destiny is secure.
- The Bible is interpreted through a consistent literal-grammatical-historical hermeneutic, affirming premillennial dispensationalism.

The site is aligned with the Grace Evangelical Society (https://faithalone.org/) and the theological legacy of Zane C. Hodges and Robert N. Wilkin.

## Articles

- [Unicorns in the King James Version](https://whosoeverbelieves.com/articles/kjv-unicorns-reem): Why the KJV renders re'em as “unicorn” nine times — the Septuagint, Pliny, and Jerome behind the reading, and the Akkadian evidence identifying the animal as the aurochs
- [The Hermeneutical Spiral](https://whosoeverbelieves.com/articles/osborne-hermeneutical-spiral): Osborne's ten-step method from text to sermon for biblical interpretation
- [Holy Spirit's Role in Salvation](https://whosoeverbelieves.com/articles/Holy-Spirit-Role-in-Believers): The Spirit's permanent ministries at justification and their implications for eternal security
- [There is a God — Book Review](https://whosoeverbelieves.com/articles/There-Is-A-God-Review): Review of Anthony Flew's journey from atheism to deism and its apologetic value
- [The Kingdom in Isaiah](https://whosoeverbelieves.com/articles/Millennial-Kingdom-Isaiah): Tracing the future messianic Kingdom through the prophet Isaiah, supporting premillennialism
- [The Calling of Romans 10:9](https://whosoeverbelieves.com/articles/Call-On-The-Lord-Romans-10): Romans 10:9–10 in context — arguing salvation refers to temporal deliverance, not the reception of eternal life
- [The Faithful Saying in Context](https://whosoeverbelieves.com/articles/Faithful-Saying-2-Timothy-211-13): Examination of 2 Timothy 2:11–13 as a chiastic structure
- [The Davidic Covenant](https://whosoeverbelieves.com/articles/Davidic-Covenant-Overview): God's unconditional promise to David of an eternal throne, yet to be fulfilled in the Millennium
- [New Covenant Promise to Israel](https://whosoeverbelieves.com/articles/New-Covenant-Jeremiah-31): Overview of Jeremiah 31 and the New Covenant
- [Synthetic Outline of Daniel](https://whosoeverbelieves.com/articles/Book-Of-Daniel-Outline): The Book of Daniel overviewed from a dispensational perspective
- [Abraham: Father of Faith](https://whosoeverbelieves.com/articles/Abraham-Father-Of-Faith): Tracing the life of Abraham through Genesis 12–23: the call to inheritance, the Melchizedek blessing, justification by faith in Genesis 15, the unconditional covenant, and the rewards of obedience.
- [Time Problems and Solutions for Biblicists](https://whosoeverbelieves.com/articles/Age-Of-The-Universe-Problems-Solutions): A survey of Christian responses to old-earth cosmology, including Day-Age, Gap Theory, Mature Creation, and Time Dilation models.
- [God's Forever Dwelling (Psalm 132)](https://whosoeverbelieves.com/articles/Gods-Forever-Dwelling-Psalm-132): A study of Psalm 132 exploring God's oath to David, the Messiah's future reign from Zion.
- [Synthetic Outline of the Gospel of John](https://whosoeverbelieves.com/articles/Gospel-Of-John-Outline): John wrote his Gospel for one stated reason: that you would believe in Jesus for everlasting life. A walk through the seven signs, the world's reaction, and the verdict John asks the reader to reach.
- [Jesus Challenging Presuppositions](https://whosoeverbelieves.com/articles/Jesus-Challenging-Presuppositions): Rather than calling the Rich Young Ruler to a life of asceticism, Jesus used hypothetical argumentation to expose the absurdity of his false assumptions about earning eternal life.
- [Profiting for the Kingdom](https://whosoeverbelieves.com/articles/Profiting-For-The-Kingdom-Mark-8): An examination of Mark 8:35–38 showing that the passage addresses discipleship and eternal rewards, not the conditions for receiving eternal life.
- [The Power to Memorize Scripture](https://whosoeverbelieves.com/articles/bible-memory-rooms): Learn how to memorize Bible verses using the ancient memory palace technique.
- [How Jesus Bookended the Old Testament](https://whosoeverbelieves.com/articles/bookending-the-ot): Jesus condemned the blood shed “from Abel to Zechariah.” Why that phrase traces the Hebrew canon cover to cover and leaves out the Apocrypha.
- [Understanding the Gospel](https://whosoeverbelieves.com/articles/free-grace-gospel): A clear explanation of the gospel — why we need salvation, what Jesus accomplished on the cross, and how eternal life is received by faith alone.
- [The Implications of God’s Transcendence](https://whosoeverbelieves.com/articles/implications-of-gods-transcendence): Why a God who exists above and outside creation must reveal Himself, keep His promises, and save by grace alone.
- [KJV Oddities, Part 2: Dragons](https://whosoeverbelieves.com/articles/kjv-dragons-tannin): Why the KJV renders both tan and tannin as “dragon,” how the word travelled from the Septuagint’s drakon through the Vulgate’s draco into 1611 English, and what the Hebrew actually described.

## Bible Study Tools

- [NT Greek Vocabulary](https://whosoeverbelieves.com/greek/vocabulary): Interactive flashcards, quizzes, and speed rounds for all 1,000 words from Mounce's Basics of Biblical Greek, filterable by chapter
- [Bible Reading Plan Generator](https://whosoeverbelieves.com/bible-reading-plans): Create, save, and track customizable Bible reading plans with user accounts
- [Maps, Charts & Timelines](https://whosoeverbelieves.com/charts/): Bible charts and timelines organized by section of Scripture and framed by a dispensational Seven Acts overview: Genesis structure, a map of the Exodus and wilderness journey, the cycle of the Judges, the kings of Israel and Judah with Thiele dates, Esther in its Persian context, a speech map and round-by-round chart of the debate in Job, the Psalms, Daniel's seventy weeks, the book of Zechariah and its prophecies of Christ's two comings, John's eight signs, a map of Paul's missionary journeys, Paul's letters, and the order of future events
